intermediate.name: Col du Haag
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Col du Haag (149.4 km)

story: No attacks came before the intermediate sprint. A large breakaway featuring Pidcock formed on the Grand Ballon, but UAE Team Emirates kept the gap under control throughout the stage. A smaller group emerged from the breakaway as Carapaz and Valentin Paret-Peintre battled for the mountain points. The breakaway was reeled in on the Col du Haag before Pogačar attacked, opened a decisive gap and rode to a solo victory.
